# Solana Consensus Lab. Everything here is public: the simulator, the guided
# lessons and the generated explainer pages.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The app is a single document whose state lives in the query string, so
# ?scenario=...&mode=...&t=... is the same page as "/". Crawling those
# permutations only spends crawl budget on identical documents, and index.html
# already declares the bare domain canonical (see the og:url comment there).
Disallow: /*?*

# Generated by scripts/build-content.ts. Kept next to robots.txt so the two stay
# obvious as a pair; do not hand-edit the sitemap.
Sitemap: https://www.solanaconsensuslab.com/sitemap.xml
